the emergence of flexible information routes in networks of neurons, a fundamental issue in brain function and a key question in neuroscience.
the question of how the intrinsic properties of neurons can determine the dynamics and the function of the network as a whole.

the firing rate can act as a tunable parameter to control the information flow and routing in the brain networks.

the emergence of a high frequency node in an undirected and otherwise homogeneous network leads to the establishment of a directed information channel, which is reliable and robust.
